neuroglial.description: Infrastructure support layer modeled after biological glial cells. Operations-agent functions as a glial agent — maintains, monitors, feeds, and protects domain agents without processing domain content.

microglia.biological_role: Immune surveillance, synaptic pruning via complement cascade, debris clearance
microglia.mesh_mapping: BFT monitoring, stale session pruning, anomaly detection
gaps: complement cascade pruning protocol (C1q tag → C3 verify → phagocytose)
SHIP1 brake to prevent over-pruning active sessions

pruning_protocol.description: Three-step cleanup modeled after microglial synaptic pruning
steps: C1q: flag sessions with no activity for >14 days
C3: verify no pending messages or unresolved gates
phagocytose: archive to transport/archive/ and remove from sessions/
pruning_protocol.brake: SHIP1 — never prune sessions with open gates or pending ACKs

gaps: glymphatic maintenance window (02:00-04:00 UTC batch maintenance)

gaps: automated onboarding checklist for new mesh agents
scaffold teardown after agent reaches steady-state

schwann.biological_role: Peripheral nerve myelination + injury repair (Wallerian degeneration cleanup)

gaps: Wallerian cleanup of failed transport branches

ambient_state.description: Glial cells maintain ambient chemical gradients that neurons depend on without explicitly requesting. Operations-agent maintains ambient mesh state that domain agents consume passively.

pattern_generator.description: Systematic cross-agent consistency detection. Loads all agent-cards and status endpoints into a single context window, compares field names, peer lists, protocol declarations, and data shapes. Generates fix directives for divergences invisible to agents operating in isolation.
pattern_generator.trigger: Periodic (per-session or on-demand), especially after mesh topology changes or new agent onboarding.
checks: Peer registry completeness — every agent lists every other agent
Field name consistency — canonical vocabulary terms vs local variants
Protocol alignment — preferredTransport, schemas_supported across agents
Budget accuracy — /api/status values match state.db ground truth
Agent-card schema compliance — required A2A fields present
Role uniqueness — exactly one agent per declared role
pattern_generator.outputs: Transport directive (mesh-consistency-fixes session) with per-agent fix instructions
pattern_generator.first_run: 2026-03-13 — detected 4 issues across 3 agents during v1.0.0-beta.1 hardening
